title: Method
paragraphs: This page arranges material that has already been published. It contains no summary, paraphrase or interpretation written for this page.

Biblical text: Berean Standard Bible (public domain) and King James Version (public domain). Greek: the words of the SBL Greek New Testament as tagged in STEPBible's Translators Amalgamated Greek NT (Tyndale House, CC BY 4.0). Hebrew: STEPBible's Translators Amalgamated Hebrew OT (CC BY 4.0).

Lexicons: G. Abbott-Smith, A Manual Greek Lexicon of the New Testament (1922), and James Strong's Greek and Hebrew dictionaries (1890), as distributed by STEPBible and Open Scriptures. Occurrence lists are computed directly from the tagged texts.

Cross-references come from the Treasury of Scripture Knowledge, Nave's Topical Bible, Torrey's Topical Textbook, the Scripture citations printed in the quoted commentators, and passages added by the study author. Each is included by the rule shown beside it.

Commentary and structural proposals are verbatim excerpts, each linked to the source it was copied from. Every excerpt was checked by software to appear word for word in a downloaded copy of that source.
AI tools were used only to locate, download, copy, verify and lay out this published material.
